# 1823. Find the Winner of the Circular Game

## Solution 1 (time O(nk), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def findTheWinner(self, n, k):
        """
        :type n: int
        :type k: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        q = deque(range(1, n + 1))
        while len(q) > 1:
            for _ in range(k - 1):
                q.append(q.popleft())
            q.popleft()
        return q[0]
```
